'''Şaban Karataş''' (1928–2016) was a Turkish academic and conservative politician who was the director general of the [[Turkish Radio and Television Corporation]] (TRT) in 1976–1977. He served at the [[Grand National Assembly of Turkey|Parliament]] in the late 1970s and 1990s. He joined different right-wing political parties, including the [[Justice Party (Turkey)|Justice Party]], the [[Welfare Party]] and the [[Nationalist Movement Party]].

==Early life and education==
Karataş was born in a village of [[Ereğli, Konya|Ereğli]], Konya, in 1928.<ref name=ebar16/> He graduated from the Faculty of Agriculture at [[Ankara University]] in 1953, receiving a degree in [[agricultural engineering]].<ref name=ebar16/> He obtained a Ph.D. in [[zootechnics]] from the same university in 1958.<ref name=ebar16/><ref name=biyog/> He also received a Ph.D. in statistics and pursued his post-doctorate studies in [[biostatistics|biometry]] and animal breeding at [[Cornell University]], USA, between 1958 and 1961.<ref name=ebar16/><ref name=marses>{{cite web|author=Ömer Akbulut|title=Müstesna Bilim, Fikir ve Mücadele Adamı Prof. Dr. Şaban Karataş Hoca|language=tr|publisher=Maarifin Sesi|access-date=18 April 2024|date=28 March 2023|url=https://www.maarifinsesi.com/mustesna-bilim-fikir-ve-mucadele-adami-prof-dr-saban-karatas-hoca/}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|title=News and Announcements|journal=[[Biometrics (journal)|Biometrics]]|volume=15|issue=3|year=1959|jstor=2527754| page=507}}</ref>

==Career and activities==
Karataş joined his alma mater as a research assistant on 30 June 1955.<ref name=tyb16/> Then he began to teach at Atatürk University and was promoted to associated professor of [[biostatistics]] on 29 November 1962.<ref name=tyb16/> He served as the chair of the Zootechnics Department at Ankara University between 18 March 1965 and 30 June 1966 and became a full professor on 30 June 1966.<ref name=tyb16/> Then he worked as the dean of the Faculty of Science and Literature and the Faculty of Agriculture at Atatürk University.<ref name=marses/> 

Karataş was appointed director general of the TRT in January 1976 replacing Nevzat Yalçıntaş in the post. Karataş's tenure ended on 22 June 1977 when the Council of State annulled his appointment as a result of [[Bülent Ecevit]]'s complaint against him and the TRT.<ref name=tyb16/> His successor in the post was Cengiz Taşer.<ref>{{cite journal|author=S. Mustafa Önen|author2=Nural İmik Tanyıldızı|title=The Administrative Supervision of Broadcasting of the Turkish Radio Television Corporation (TRT): Can the British Broadcasting Corporation (BBC) Provide a Model? |journal=Amme İdaresi Dergisi|date=September 2010|volume=4|issue=3|page=131|url=https://avesis.inonu.edu.tr/yayin/7ca1d350-279e-4cee-921a-920d3760fc62/the-administrative-control-of-broadcasting-of-the-turkish-radio-television-corporation-trt-can-the-british-broadcasting-corporation-bbc-provide-a-model}}</ref>

Karataş was elected as a member of the Parliament in the 1979 [[by-election]] for the Justice Party representing Konya. His tenure was cut short due to the [[1980 Turkish coup d'état|military coup]] on 12 September 1980. Following the coup, Karataş was among the Justice Party members whose political activities were banned by the military regime.<ref name=marses/>

After his ban was lifted in 1987 Karataş served as the head of the Ankara branch of the [[Intellectuals' Hearth]].<ref name=marses/> He became a member of the Parliament in the [[1995 Turkish general election|1995 general election]] for the Welfare Party from Ankara. He joined the Nationalist Movement Party when the Welfare Party was banned in January 1998. Karataş's tenure at the Parliament ended in 1999 when he did not win his seat from Konya in the [[1999 Turkish general election|general election]].<ref name=ebar16>{{cite web|author=Efendi Barutçu|title=Şaban Karataş Hocaya Rahmet|url=https://www.ulkuyaz.org.tr/efendi-barutcu-saban-karatas-hocaya-rahmet/|website=ulkuyaz.org|language=tr|date=16 February 2016}}</ref> 

Karataş was also a member of the [[Middle East Technical University]]'s board of trustees. He was the founding chair of the [[Bezmialem Vakıf University]]'s board of trustees.<ref name=biyog/> 

===Work and views===
Karataş published a book entitled ''İstatistiğe Giriş'' ({{langx|tr|Introduction to Statistics}}) in 1963.<ref name=marses/> He also published a book on his term at the TRT entitled ''TRT Kavgası'' ({{langx|tr|TRT Fight}}).<ref name=tyb16/>

Karataş was respectful for the will of the nation and extremely loyal to the Republic of Turkey, but he was not a [[Kemalism|Kemalist]].<ref name=ebar16/>

==Personal life and death==
Karataş was married and had two children.<ref name=biyog>{{cite web|title=Şaban Karataş|language=tr|website=Biyografya|access-date=18 April 2024|url=https://www.biyografya.com/biyografi/22400}}</ref> He died in Ankara on 14 February 2016 and was buried in the Gölbaşı cemetery on 16 February.<ref name=ebar16/><ref name=tyb16>{{cite web|title=TRT’nin efsanevi Genel müdürü Şaban Karataş vefat etti|website=Türkiye Yazarlar Birliği|date=15 February 2016|url=https://www.tyb.org.tr/trtnin-efsanevi-genel-muduru-saban-karatas-vefat-etti-24057h.htm|language=tr|access-date=18 April 2024}}</ref>
